links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy versus information-gathering efficiency and medication safety in consultation agents
links.effect: Across 19 LLMs, high diagnostic accuracy often masks significant deficiencies in information-gathering efficiency and medication safety, indicating a gap between medical knowledge and clinical practice ability.
links.quote: Systematic evaluation of 19 large language models reveals that high diagnostic accuracy often masks significant deficiencies in information-gathering efficiency and medication safety.

unlisted_practices: Process-aware benchmark with atomic information units to evaluate history-taking efficiency across the full consultation cycle
Testing medication regimen compatibility and constraint-respecting plan revisions in follow-up Q&A

screen.reason: The paper introduces and tests MedConsultBench, an automated evaluation benchmark framework for medical consultation agents across 19 LLMs, focusing on process integrity and clinical safety metrics.
